pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation using a shredder-chipper to ground giant reed to pass through a 12 mm sieve
Ensilage: supplementation with water to reach approximately 40% total solids (TS), vacuum packing in zipper bags to minimize oxygen, and incubation at room temperature (25 ± 3 °C) for 60 days
Thermal pretreatment via autoclaving at 121 °C for 30 min

Fungal pretreatment using Ceriporiopsis subvermispora (ATCC 96608) inoculum, supplemented with sterilized DI water to obtain a final moisture content of around 70% (w/w, wet basis), and incubated at 28 ± 1 °C for 30 days
